contax.description:
Complete management of device, SIM card, and account contacts with encrypted backup

View contacts from all sources: device storage, SIM 1, SIM 2, Google, Exchange
Quick filter by source + source label next to each contact
Add, edit, delete, favorite, call, and send SMS
Complete fields: multiple numbers with labels (mobile/home/work), email, organization, address, notes, and photo
Copy / move contacts between sources (device ↔ SIM ↔ accounts), individually or in bulk
Multi-select for bulk delete, move, copy, and backup

And more options...
